plan.notes: Official NKU SAMPLE 4-YEAR PLAN: Psychology B.A. with NKU Occupational Therapy Prerequisites (OT prereq courses highlighted in the official PDF; all are embedded in the plan). Hosted on nku.edu (CHHS/Kent School of Social Work advising pages); PDF is undated, retrieved 2026-10-02, matching the current catalog course numbering. STA 205 may instead be taken in the fall of sophomore year. Any six hours of a foreign language satisfy the B.A. language requirement; a 3-credit study abroad course may substitute. OT prereqs per the PDF: BIO 208 & 209, ENG 102 (Advanced College Writing), PHY 211, PSY 100, SOC 100, PSY 321, PSY 333, STA 205, BIO 272 (each with min grade C, max two attempts). PHY 211 requires MAT 119 or a minimal math ACT score of 25 or equivalent placement (placement note, not a plan course). The plan publishes no course-level prereq data; prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
